abstract_sentences.text: Memory formation is fundamental to intelligence, yet whether deep neural networks preserve identifiable memory traces analogous to biological memory units remains an open question.
abstract_sentences.transition: opens the gap that sentence 2 operationalizes

abstract_sentences.text: This work introduces a geometric framework to identify such “AI engrams” by formalizing the neuroscientific criteria of specificity, reactivation, sufficiency, and necessity into a constrained inverse problem.
abstract_sentences.transition: turns the gap into four operational constraints

abstract_sentences.text: We derive a closed-form estimator that isolates individual memory traces from globally entangled parameters, and show that this biologically-derived solution corresponds to a natural gradient update on the parameter manifold.
AI engrams enable surgical manipulation of learned knowledge: any subset of memories can be composed or erased through linear arithmetic, without iterative optimization.
abstract_sentences.transition: turns the estimator into an editing capability

abstract_sentences.text: Experiments ranging from simple MLPs to LLMs demonstrate the causal validity and substantial scalability of AI engrams.
abstract_sentences.transition: claims empirical coverage for the capability

abstract_sentences.text: Together, these results bridge theories of biological memory and artificial representation learning and offer geometric insight into how deep networks simultaneously support functional specificity within distributed storage.
abstract_sentences.comparison_target: biological memory and artificial representation learning
abstract_sentences.transition: ends with disciplinary and explanatory impact

equation_theory_inventory.label: Proposition 4.1
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: Hard specificity W+X−=0 and uncentered covariances.
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: Eq. (3) is the minimum-norm closed-form solution.

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 6.1
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: K-FAC layer factorization and isotropic output curvature Gl≈σ²I.
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: The Engram objective is the minimum-norm projection under the Fisher metric.
equation_theory_inventory.empirical_correspondence: No direct curvature diagnostic is supplied.

equation_theory_inventory.label: Corollary 6.3
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: The K-FAC and isotropic-curvature assumptions used in Theorem 6.1.
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: Ablation W−W+ corresponds to unit-step natural-gradient descent on Lforget.
equation_theory_inventory.empirical_correspondence: Table 2 and Table 3 test editing behavior rather than the trajectory itself.

equation_theory_inventory.label: Proposition A.1
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: Target reconstruction objective and exact reference null-space constraint.

experimental_design.name: predeclared experimental organization
experimental_design.description: Section 5 enumerates versatility/scalability, quantitative comparisons, and qualitative demonstrations before presenting them.

experimental_design.name: CIFAR class-wise task
experimental_design.description: CIFAR-10/100 use ResNet-18/50; Class 0 is forgotten while the other classes form the retain set.

experimental_design.name: architectures and datasets
experimental_design.description: Appendix B specifies CIFAR ResNets, MNIST ConvAE, CelebA WAE, and ImageNet-1K ViT-B/16.

experimental_design.name: LLM task
experimental_design.description: TOFU forget10 on Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct starts from a full-parameter fine-tuned model and retains 90% of training data.

experimental_design.name: baselines
experimental_design.description: CIFAR comparison names Fine-tune, NegGrad, NegGrad+, l1-Sparse, Random Label, and SalUn; LLM comparison adds GradDiff, Idk variants, UNDIAL, RMU, NPO, SimNPO, and AltPO.

experimental_design.name: covariance extraction
experimental_design.description: Target and reference uncentered covariances are accumulated in a single forward pass with B=128.

experimental_design.name: numerical implementation
experimental_design.description: The pseudoinverse is computed with SVD and singular values below 10−6×λmax are thresholded.

experimental_design.name: CIFAR selection and seeds
experimental_design.description: Hyperparameters are selected by ToW grid search; after selection each method is run with five random seeds, with original and retrained models using corresponding seeds.

experimental_design.name: CIFAR metrics
experimental_design.description: ToW is based on absolute accuracy differences to a retrained reference over forget, retain, and test sets; DA, NMI, and CKA extend to representation comparisons.

experimental_design.name: LLM metrics
experimental_design.description: LLM evaluation covers normalized Memorization, Utility, and Privacy, with EM, FQ/KS, and four MIA AUC variants defined in Appendix E.

experimental_design.name: hardware and cost scope
experimental_design.description: Engram extraction runs on one NVIDIA A100 80GB; LLM cost estimates assume batch 2, sequence length 256, and one A100.

experimental_design.name: reported omissions
experimental_design.description: No LLM seed count, raw per-seed values, or interval estimates are presented in the main/appendix result tables; Algorithm pseudocode is absent.

limitations.name: functional identification rather than learning-trajectory reconstruction
limitations.description: Eq. (4) isolates functionally separable subspaces of the converged manifold; it conflates pretraining and fine-tuning contributions instead of reconstructing concept-specific historical perturbations.

evidence.anchor: not reconstructions of the weight perturbations

limitations.name: concept dataset requirement
limitations.description: The method requires explicit target X+ and reference X− datasets, requiring human labels or domain knowledge.

limitations.name: retrospective-only estimation
limitations.description: The current framework cannot enter the training loop for online tracking or apply directly to streaming/incremental learning.

limitations.name: covariance storage at larger scale
limitations.description: Although it avoids O(Nd) activation storage, d×d covariances can become substantial at 8B–70B scale.

limitations.name: compute-accuracy trade-off
limitations.description: The main text states that Engram trails AltPO, NPO, and SimNPO on Overall and Privacy metrics, while using a one-pass gradient-free regime.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 以四个 neuroscience criteria 约束 target/reference covariance 的 inverse problem，文章得到可并行的 spectral projection，并用它做 post-hoc functional memory isolation 和 linear editing。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 criterion-to-constraint translation、Eq. (2)–(4)、CIFAR main results、Fisher interpretation、LLM tables 和 compute–accuracy positioning。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 推导、protocol、metric definitions、hyperparameter grids、large-scale visual matrices、component ablation、compute accounting 和完整限制进入 Appendices A–H；复现和尺度边界依赖这些材料。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Table 1 先把跨学科术语固定成可观察干预条件，Eq. (2) 压缩为 objective，Eq. (4) 交付 estimator，再用 heatmap、scatter 和 table 分担 behavior、representation 与 benchmark evidence。
final_judgment.largest_gap: functional component 与真实 learning-trajectory contribution 有明确差异；四项 neuroscience criteria 未被逐项独立、跨任务量化验证，关键限制集中到 Appendix H。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 将概念性因果主张逐一转为可观测 intervention condition，先导出最小 objective 和 estimator，再为每项能力主张配置直接的 behavior-level evidence object。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则适合已有 target/reference datasets、可取 trained weights/activations、且目标是 functional intervention 的场景；它不能替代 online tracking、无监督 concept discovery 或历史归因。
